posts.hook: washington overrode a state's gambling law to keep one company alive, the same day it hit a $40b valuation
posts.caption: the trump administration overrides new york's gambling law to keep kalshi running while it talks to raise at a $40b valuation, anthropic is in talks to buy video startup decart for $6b, and a supply-chain breach leaked credentials from microsoft, amazon and cisco. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: washington overrides new york's gambling law to keep kalshi running
slides.desc: the same week it's in talks to raise at a $40b valuation, nearly double may's $22b

slides.title: anthropic is in talks to buy video ai startup decart for $6b
slides.desc: folding real-time video generation and gpu efficiency work straight into its stack

slides.title: twitch finally lets streamers opt out of training amazon's ai

slides.desc: microsoft, amazon, cisco, samsung and salesforce keys were all exposed via litellm
